name: Narbada Gems & Jewellery Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Narbada Gems and Jewellery Ltd manufactures and trades in Gold, Color Stones and Diamond jewellery with emphasis on rose cut and flat diamond jewellery[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company focuses on making handcrafted jewellery. It has its own in - house designing and development team which includes Jewellery designers, merchandisers and creative head

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.03% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.63% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 66.6 to 87.7 days.
